Greetings, Agents!

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

Agents, are you ready to join the magnificent Krakoan party held in honor of the newest X-Men?
Here are the new Uniforms for Psylocke, Mister Sinister, and Colossus 

introduced through this additional patch.

 

Check out the three heroes who have gained even more power by downloading the 1/4 patch.  

 

■ 1/4 Patch Details 

 

Patch schedule: 1/5 (Wed) 3:00 (UTC+0) / 1/4 (Tue) 19:00 (PST) 

* The patch will be applied in waves, so the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch. 
* When the patch is done, please restart and apply the patch for better service.

 

[1/5 (Wed) 3:01 (UTC+0), 1/4 (Tue) 19:01 (PST) added]

The patch has been completed as of 1/5 (Wed) 2:59 (UTC+0), 1/4 (Tue) 18:59 (PST). 

Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.

 

▣ Three New Uniforms


These three Mutants have showed up with a new look 
to attend the Hellfire Club Gala that will be held in Krakoa!
 
Check out the abilities of Captain Britain <Hellfire Gala>, 
Mister Sinister <Hellfire Gala>, and Colossus <Hellfire Gala> Uniforms.
 

* The new Uniforms can be purchased after the 1/4 patch data is applied  
  and new Uniforms will be on sale for 40% off.
* The 3 new Uniforms can be found and purchased in the Marvel Universe and the Uniform Room. 
* Skills are based on the maximum stats.

 

 

 

 

▣  Psylocke, Mister Sinister, and Colossus Potential Awakening & Transcend Potential

 

Potential Awakening & Transcend Potential have been added 
to the three Mutant heroes Psylocke, Mister Sinister, and Colossus!
Please look forward to the performance of the Mutant heroes who have gained even more power

 

 

 

 

 

▣ New Artifacts

 

Artifacts have been added for Psylocke, Mister Sinister, and Colossus.

 

* The effects are based on the 6★ Artifact passive skill LV.4 stats.

 

▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. The issue of the heroes only being sorted by level when setting the filter to <Unique Ability> 

in the team information screen of Shadowland has been fixed.


2. The issue of the boss not appearing when playing the Epic Quest 

The Fate of Mankind - The Showdown stage with Rocket Raccoon, 

Groot <Snowflake Festival>, and Groot <Guardians of the Galaxy 2> has been fixed.


3. The issue of the reforging success / failed text being wrongly displayed 

when reforging Brilliant C.T.P. has been fixed.

 

[1/5 (Wed) 3:41 (UTC+0), 1/4 (Tue) 19:41 (PST) added]

4. The theme title of Epic Quest <The Fate of Mankind>: the story of Kingo 

has been fixed from [New Role] to [Not an Act].

 

5. The text for some skill options have been changed.
Before: +N% Increase of ALL BASIC ATTACKS INCREASE 

each N% Accumulated Damage proportional to max accumulated Damage.
After: +N% Increase of ALL BASIC ATTACKS 

each N% Accumulated Damage proportional to max accumulated Damage.

 

We look forward to your interest in the events 
that will be held in celebration of the new Uniforms.

 

Thank you.
